title: Release settings save lock before refresh
summary: Settings save success now schedules the broad WebView refresh without awaiting it inside the settings command busy window.
reason: Saving LibraryProfiles during active backend work could leave the WebView controls disabled when the post-save refresh stalled or stayed in progress.
behavior_before: Successful settings saves awaited refreshAll before setSettingsCommandBusy(false), so a slow active-run refresh could keep settings/library controls locked.
behavior_after: Successful settings saves release the command busy state immediately after the save request completes and start refreshAll on a timer.
rollback_plan: Revert the settingsView.js helper and restore awaited refreshAll calls in the settings save paths; revert the matching static test assertions.
notes:
Release settings command busy state before broad post-save refresh so active-run refresh stalls do not freeze controls.
Update static settings UI assertions for non-blocking post-save refresh scheduling.
Assert saveSettingsPatch releases the command lock without awaiting refreshAll.
